messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 14 Sept
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (FileSite) will be unavailable this Saturday 14 September from 06:00 to 12:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please ensure any documents are checked in before Friday close. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
